jobs.description: Home How it works Content marketing ops Pricing Book a demo Resource center Enjoy the run Home How it works Content marketing ops Pricing Book a demo Resource center Enjoy the run How it works The platform your entire operation runs on, we've got your herd! Not just what your team does today. What they haven't had the infrastructure to attempt yet. Not just one model, click to choose which AI runs; Claude, Codex, Gemini, or any other. Bizone connects your workflows into a single intelligent system, agents that learn how you operate, automate every step, and get sharper with every run. Fully auditable. Works on any system. Scales without breaking. Perpetual learning system The how becomes invisible. The what becomes unstoppable. Dream the workflow. We'll build it. You run it with the force of a bizone herd. You know that process your team does manually, the one that's too complex to automate, too expensive to engineer, always pushed to "next quarter" ? Describe it. If we choose yours, we build it into Bizone, and give you 3 months of full access, on us . No pitch. No demo. Just write down what running at full speed looks like for your team. Submit your workflow idea Start with content marketing → The process Four steps from your knowledge to an AI-powered workflow Bizone is structured so you stay in control at every stage. Your expertise drives the process, AI accelerates it. 01 Sit with one of our experts to map out your process exactly the way you know it works Use Bizone's visual canvas to map out what actually needs to happen, based on how you know it works, not how an engineer thinks it should. Choose from pre-built templates or build from scratch. No code. 02 Assign each step to a human, an AI agent, or both. Review only what you defined needed HITL (Human in the loop) Each step gets assigned to a human, an AI agent, or both running in parallel. You decide where AI fits. You control how much it does. Your judgment defines the boundaries. 03 Dial up AI autonomy step by step, at your own pace As confidence builds, you dial up. Reduce parallel human slots. Set auto-approval thresholds where you're comfortable. Every decision is logged, rollback is always one click away. 04 Full governance and audit logging runs automatically beneath you Every action is logged. Every role is scoped. Every output is auditable just as required for true governance. Bizone is fully hosted, so your IT are happy, and you focus on the work. Under the hood Three layers. One clean surface. Bizone's architecture keeps complexity invisible. You work at the surface, the platform handles the rest. Layer 1 User experience layer Where you define outcomes, run processes, review outputs, and stay in control. Visual canvas. No code. No complexity. This is all you see. Layer 2 AI participation layer Where AI agents are introduced into specific steps, compared with human outputs, and gradually given more autonomy, at the pace you set. Layer 3 Governed runtime layer Audit trail, RBAC, permissions, data isolation, and safe execution. Fully abstracted. Fully Bizone's responsibility, not yours. See it on your workflow In a matter of days we'll take your actual process and map it to Bizone live. Book a demo The operating system for AI-native workflows. Built for the experts who already know what to do, now with the tools to do it at AI speed.
